blocks.title: General information, not medical advice
blocks.body: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] MamaBabyBites shares general information about food and feeding. It is not medical advice and does not replace your pediatrician, OB-GYN, midwife, registered dietitian or lactation consultant. Every mom and baby is different.

blocks.title: If you're worried
blocks.body: [PLACEHOLDER - needs expert review] If you are worried about your baby's health or your own, please contact your doctor or healthcare provider. In an emergency, call 911.
